_notes: Register decision: Agency console = concise operational 'Ty' (Twoja odpowiedź, Twoi podopieczni) or impersonal; University console = formal 'Państwo'/impersonal. All existing informal plural 'Wasza uczelnia / Wam' in university keys were re-rendered as 'Państwa uczelnia / Państwu' or impersonal, and agency keys stay on 'Ty'.
638 of 1002 console keys had no Polish (cur = null); all are translated here. Plural families get _one/_few/_many/_other where the EN had only _one/_other.

application = 'aplikacja' in both consoles ('wniosek', 'zgłoszenie' removed); university's own review of an application = 'ocena' (W trakcie oceny, Rozpocznij ocenę); agency document review = 'weryfikacja'; the university's formal document check = 'sprawdzenie dokumentów' (was 'weryfikacja', which collided with the agency term).

admission offer = 'oferta przyjęcia' / 'oferta'; 'Offer accepted' = 'Oferta zaakceptowana' (was both 'Oferta przyjęta' and 'Przyjęli ofertę'); enrollment = 'zapis na studia'; 'Not admitted' = 'decyzja odmowna' (gender-neutral, matches common).

Stage labels in the agency pipeline are nominal (Aplikacja złożona, Po przyjeździe) rather than masculine participles. 'Reply owed' chip = 'Do odpowiedzi'. 'Waiting on us' = 'Czeka na nas'. Hangyul HQ = 'Centrala Hangyul'. Admission guide = 'przewodnik rekrutacyjny' (v27.guide.missingTitle said 'Zasady rekrutacji').

Standard admission letter spelled out as 'standardowy list przyjęcia (Standard Admission Letter)' where the full document is meant (ws.noVisaText, decision.certificateInfo); short statuses keep 'list przyjęcia'.
university:kpi.yield rendered descriptively as 'Wskaźnik zapisów po ofercie' because 'yield' has no admissions term in Polish; owner may prefer the English 'Yield'.
agency:v27.evidence.ageDays '{{count}} dni temu' assumes the field reads 'Issued within: N days ago'; if it is a bare duration, '{{count}} dni' is enough.
